Pipeline and Regulatory Highlights: • IHEEZO QUELL Study: Announced topline results from QUELL, a Phase 4, randomized, double-masked study of 231 patients undergoing intravitreal injections.
Full results are expected to be presented at the Hawaiian Eye & Retina Conference in January 2027.
Initial clinical data is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026 with a more robust interim read to be provided at our upcoming Investor's Day presentation in New York in March of 2027.
